concerns.text: T067's verification says to confirm contract-conformance 'against the schemas in specs/001-transferability-of-dft-d3-dispersion-to-/contracts/', but plan.md's Project Structure places the spec tree at 'specs/PROJ-735-transferability-of-dft-d3-dispersion-to-/' (and the constitution's project ID matches the latter). The implementer cannot deterministically resolve which directory to validate against; the verification step may check a nonexistent path and fail spuriously. Fix the path in T067 to the actual contracts/ location.

T067 requires re-running the full pipeline 'as documented in the active feature's quickstart.md', but no task verifies quickstart.md exists or contains runnable commands, and the completed-work list does not mention it. If quickstart.md is missing or lacks the load→psi4→analyze→scale→correlate→report command sequence, T067's verification is not executable as written. Add an explicit precondition or a check that quickstart.md documents each stage's invocation command.
